In `sentry_patched_make_api_call`, `_finish_span(span)` is called unconditionally after `_instrument_streaming_body(span, parsed)`, regardless of whether a streaming body was found and instrumented. Thus, a call returning an unread `StreamingBody` has its client span finished before that body is consumed or closed; the separate streaming span does not keep the client span open.
YES
